action_items.task: Update the reconciliation job to read the idempotency key
Write the ADR for the idempotent retries decision
Own the rollout plan (web client first, then mobile client in the release after next)
Write the stakeholder update to the support team that duplicate charges will stop after the mobile release

decisions.decision: Adopt idempotent retries with a client dedupe key (Option A); do not build the server dedupe table
decisions.rationale: Option B would block two real payments of the same amount within the window, and the gateway already supports an idempotency key header so only clients need to change

decisions.decision: Rollout order: web client first, then the mobile client in the release after next

summary.summary: Architecture review on idempotent retries for payment requests. The team chose Option A (client-side dedupe key) over Option B (server dedupe table) to avoid blocking legitimate same-amount payments. Theo will update the reconciliation job, Jun will write the ADR by Wednesday, Mira will own the rollout plan (web first, then mobile), and Me will draft the stakeholder update for the support team.
